capabilities: search SteamGridDB for game images by note title
select the correct game and image through interactive modals
embed the chosen image at the cursor in the active note
trigger image embedding automatically from Templater templates
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search SteamGridDB and embed game cover art, so users must find and download images manually.

relations.evidence: Search SteamGridDB: Find game images by name.
Templater Integration: Automate image embedding when creating notes from templates.

summary: Image embedder that searches SteamGridDB for game cover art and inserts the chosen image into the active note.
